data.title: La Violeta
data.about:
La Violeta is a serene addition to Villanova, with 3 and 4 bedroom townhouses. 

The homes are meticulously created with straight lines that produce a modern aspect while blending the architecture with the lush surroundings. The most recent release is one of Dubai’s most desirable and popular communities offers plenty of greenery and amenities for residents to enjoy life outside of their four walls.

characteristics_module.title: Superior Finishing and Open Layout Designed for Contemporary Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
3 BR townhouse starting at AED 1.455M
Pay 50% on handover in March 2025
Superior finishing and open layout designed for contemporary living.
Nestled in a serene quarter of Villanova, a family-friendly master community
Fantastic amenities which include a nursery, kids’ playgrounds, pools, gym, outdoor fitness areas, etc.
Direct access to Emirates Road
